candidates.exact_span: Flow shall be estimated daily when discharging.
candidates.computation_change_reason: The phrase 'when discharging' makes flow estimation discharge-contingent; different readings of whether discharge occurred in a given period change whether monitoring was required (B) and how to classify periods without flow data (C).

candidates.exact_span: Estimated flow measurements are not subject to the accuracy provisions established at Part III.C.6 of the permit.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Whether flow is excluded from Part III.C.6 accuracy provisions affects whether reported flow values are subject to enforceable numeric limit comparison versus report-only treatment.

candidates.exact_span: The pollutant TRC shall be monitored daily when discharging by instantaneous grab which according to Part 136 is defined as analysis within 15 minutes of collection.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Discharge-contingent daily monitoring and the Part 136 grab definition affect whether TRC monitoring was required in specific periods (B) and how to treat missing TRC results when discharge status is unclear (C).

candidates.exact_span: pH shall continue to be monitored weekly when discharging.
candidates.computation_change_reason: The 'when discharging' condition governs weekly pH monitoring applicability; different discharge-occurrence interpretations change required-monitoring determinations (B) and missing-data classification (C).

candidates.exact_span: TDS and Cyanide total recoverable shall be monitored once per quarter by grab sample.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Unlike flow, TRC, and pH, this quarterly requirement lacks an explicit 'when discharging' qualifier; whether it applies regardless of discharge occurrence changes which monitoring obligations were in force.

candidates.exact_span: the permit does not require WET limits.
candidates.computation_change_reason: States that no WET numeric limits apply, affecting whether WET measurements can be compared to enforceable discharge limits.

candidates.exact_span: WET limits will not be established in the proposed permit.
candidates.computation_change_reason: Confirms absence of enforceable numeric WET limits, distinguishing WET testing from numeric compliance comparison.

The 'Report' value designation and Once/Term frequency indicate report-only WET monitoring without a numeric limit (A), establish a permit-term monitoring obligation (B), and affect how absent WET results are classified (C).
Same report-only, once-per-term WET requirement structure as Ceriodaphnia dubia, affecting limit applicability (A), monitoring obligation timing (B), and missing-evidence semantics (C).
